entities.summary: Antonio Baños Boncompain is a Spanish Catalan musician, journalist and writer. In the Catalan parliamentary election of 2015 he led Popular Unity Candidacy – Constituent Call, a pro-independence left-wing electoral list until he resigned in 2016.
